items.title: Pro Football Hall Of Fame Makes Major Changes In Voting Process After Bill Belichick Snub
items.summary: The Pro Football Hall of Fame will reduce the number of selectors from 50 to 28, part of an overhaul of the selection process after Bill Belichick was snubbed.
